//go:build postingedgebench

package postingedge

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"runtime/pprof"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/sirupsen/logrus"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/weaviate/weaviate/adapters/repos/db/lsmkv"
	"github.com/weaviate/weaviate/adapters/repos/db/vector/hnsw/distancer"
	"github.com/weaviate/weaviate/entities/cyclemanager"
	ent "github.com/weaviate/weaviate/entities/vectorindex/postingedge"
)

// TestHeap100k opens the index TestIntegrationScale left in PE_DIR as its
// open does, but with no cycle and no maintenance, collects, and writes the
// profile of the heap in use to PE_HEAP and what the index holds to PE_OUT.
// Run it with -test.memprofilerate=1. The same file builds at b6200010ab and
// at the head of m2 (the regression check of 2026-11-27 in bench-report.md).
func TestHeap100k(t *testing.T) {
	dir, heapOut, out := os.Getenv("PE_DIR"), os.Getenv("PE_HEAP"), os.Getenv("PE_OUT")
	if dir == "" || heapOut == "" || out == "" {
		t.Skip("no PE_DIR, PE_HEAP and PE_OUT given")
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	logger := logrus.New()
	logger.SetLevel(logrus.WarnLevel)
	begin := time.Now()
	noop := cyclemanager.NewCallbackGroupNoop()
	store, err := lsmkv.New(filepath.Join(dir, "lsm"), dir, logger, nil, nil, noop, noop, noop)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	p, err := Open(PersistentConfig{
		ID:                "main",
		ShardName:         "integration",
		ClassName:         "Integration",
		RootPath:          dir,
		Logger:            logger,
		DistanceProvider:  distancer.NewCosineDistanceProvider(),
		MakeBucketOptions: lsmkv.MakeBucketOptions(lsmkv.MakeRegularBucketOptions),
		BaseSize:          10000,
		Seed:              1,
		noMaintenance:     true,
	}, ent.NewDefaultUserConfig(), store)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	opened := time.Since(begin)
	defer func() {
		require.NoError(t, p.Shutdown(ctx))
		require.NoError(t, store.Shutdown(ctx))
	}()
	runtime.GC()
	runtime.GC()
	var mem runtime.MemStats
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&mem)
	file, err := os.Create(heapOut)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NoError(t, pprof.Lookup("heap").WriteTo(file, 0))
	require.NoError(t, file.Close())

	p.mu.RLock()
	g := p.g
	info := map[string]any{
		"openSeconds": opened.Seconds(), "heapInuse": mem.HeapInuse, "heapAlloc": mem.HeapAlloc,
		"meta": g.meta, "liveSlots": len(g.live), "deletedLen": len(g.deleted), "builtAtLen": len(g.builtAt),
		"codeWords": len(g.st.side.codes),
	}
	p.mu.RUnlock()
	g.retiredMu.RLock()
	live := 0
	for _, retired := range g.retired {
		if !retired {
			live++
		}
	}
	g.retiredMu.RUnlock()
	info["livePostings"] = live
	stats, err := g.st.centroids.graph.Stats()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	info["centroidGraph"] = map[string]any{
		"layers": stats.DistributionLayers, "tombstones": stats.NumTombstones, "compressed": stats.Compressed,
	}
	raw, err := json.MarshalIndent(info, "", "  ")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(out, raw, 0o644))
	t.Logf("opened in %s: heap in use %.1f MB, allocated and in use %.1f MB", opened.Round(time.Millisecond),
		float64(mem.HeapInuse)/1e6, float64(mem.HeapAlloc)/1e6)
}
